notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only the bounded non-timestamped, non-region IEEE 1516.1-2025 Request Attribute Value Update response path in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. A requester solicits a currently owning provider, the provider answers from inside the official Provide Attribute Value Update callback by invoking the official non-timestamped Update Attribute Values service, and the requester receives the resulting Reflect Attribute Values callback with the provider's response tag, producer identity, and FOM-selected mandatory transportation type. It does not claim regional requests, automatic values without federate code, timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM, update-rate reduction, custom transportation, FOM sharing policy, save/restore, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, or conformance. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs exported by the Requirements Lab.
